dedupe_keys.name: spei hr global high resolution 5 km drought indices 1981 2022

description: Global gridded drought index records at 5 km resolution. The Earth System Science Data paper (2023) says the authors computed the standardised precipitation evapotranspiration index (SPEI) at time scales of 1 to 48 months for 1981 to 2022 from four combinations of precipitation (CHIRPS v2 and MSWEP v2.8) and potential evapotranspiration (GLEAM v3.7a and hourly PET), and evaluated them against observation-based SPEI, root zone soil moisture and vegetation health. The data are free downloadable files at CEDA (doi 10.5285/ac43da11867243a1bb414e1637802dec) and on JASMIN; the paper is CC BY 4.0. Coverage is global land. Caveats: the four records differ by input, so users should compare them. For simulation it gives local drought severity through time, to drive crop, water supply and hydropower drought impact models. A related catalogue record is the global drought hazard SPEI return periods.
